parameters.query:
SELECT brand, model, reference
FROM tracked_references
WHERE active
ORDER BY id;

INSERT INTO market_prices
    (source, external_id, seller, brand, reference, title, condition, price, currency, price_usd, country, url)
VALUES
    ('ebay', $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::NUMERIC, $8,
     ROUND($7::NUMERIC / (SELECT per_usd FROM fx_rates WHERE currency = $8), 2),
     NULLIF($9, ''), $10)
ON CONFLICT (source, external_id, observed_on) DO NOTHING;

parameters.content:
## eBay prices (official API)
Searches eBay in 5 countries for every active row in `tracked_references`, removes junk (straps, empty boxes, replicas...) and saves the asking prices.

**Credential:** *OAuth2 API* on **Search eBay** - Grant type *Client Credentials*, Access token URL `https://api.ebay.com/identity/v1/oauth2/token`, Scope `https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope`, Authentication *Header*.

**Other sources:** WatchCharts (paid API) can be added as another HTTP Request node; auction results, dealers and Chrono24 go in through workflow 03 (form).
